subtasks.title: Write-path CH connect timeout 2->5 + retries 0->1 (env-driven, write-specific keys), documented + pinned by test
subtasks.approach: On the clarity_clickhouse_write connection ONLY: change timeout_connect => env('CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CONNECT', 5) and retries => env('CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_RETRIES', 1). Leave clarity_clickhouse and public_clickhouse on the shared env('CLICKHOUSE_TIMEOUT_CONNECT', 2) / env('CLICKHOUSE_RETRIES', 0) (Dalton's Q1 decision keeps read-path fast-fail). Document the new write keys (plus the previously-undocumented shared read keys) in .env.example near the existing CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_* block. Update the OKF wiki line that calls the 2s timeout 'intentional'. TDD: add a config-resolution test asserting the write connection resolves timeout_connect>=5 and retries>=1; do NOT touch the existing propagation test.

intended_diffs.config/database.php: In the 'clarity_clickhouse_write' array: 'timeout_connect' => env('CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CONNECT', 5), and 'retries' => env('CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_RETRIES', 1). No other connection touched.
intended_diffs..env.example: Add CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CONNECT=5 and CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_RETRIES=1 (and the read-path CLICKHOUSE_TIMEOUT_CONNECT / CLICKHOUSE_RETRIES which were also undocumented) with brief comments, grouped with the existing CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_USERNAME/PASSWORD keys.
intended_diffs.okf/concepts/clickhouse-integration.md: Reword the 'timeouts are intentionally low (CLICKHOUSE_TIMEOUT_CONNECT=2 ...)' line to note the write path now uses CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CONNECT=5 + CLICKHOUSE_WRITE_RETRIES=1 to absorb CH Cloud TLS/idle-scaling connect latency (DEV-2123), while read paths keep the 2s fast-fail.
intended_diffs.tests/Feature/Jobs/TrackAnalyticsTest.ph: Add test asserting config('database.connections.clarity_clickhouse_write.timeout_connect') >= 5 and config(...'.retries') >= 1. Leave test_propagates_clickhouse_connect_timeout_instead_of_swallowing untouched.
